text_block_list.text:
On this day, Tamamo Cross was at karaoke 
with her friends, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Why not?! When it comes to the first song 
at karaoke, it's gotta be 'Osaka Parade'!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Whaddya mean?! If we're gonna sing first, 
it's gotta be the 'Oedo Ondo', obviously!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo & Inari
text_block_list.text: Gnnngh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they're both so excited and cute♪ 
Ah, if you get tired from singing, just 
let me know, okay? You can rest your heads 
on my lap~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Which dish should I order...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ain't no way... These guys have zero 
intention of singing at all...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, you two. You can eat and sleep 
anywhere, can't you?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Once you're at karaoke, singing and 
dancing is the only stylish way to do it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Singin' together is what 
karaoke is all about!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, my~ So Tama-chan and Inari-chan are 
going to sing for us?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this? You two are singing 
together? I'd love to hear that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No, that wasn't what I meant...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Either way, if someone doesn't 
sing, the fire won't get lit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Then let's the two of us go in there and 
blow 'em away with a bang!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heh... If that's how it is, then it's time 
for the great Tamamo Cross to step up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What'd you say?! I was definitely way 
better, weren't I?!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous! You're just loud, 
that's all! My singing was definitely way 
better!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Both Tama-chan and Inari-chan looked like 
they were having so much fun singing. It's 
truly wonderful~♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That was so much fun. And my stomach 
is full, too... I'd love for all of us to 
go to karaoke again.
